text:
DeployBot: ALERT embeddings recall dropped ~32% vs baseline after v4.1.0 roll; affected route=embeddings, regions=us-west-2 + eu-central-1, impacted: dedicated-pools 7 and 9. auto-revert score=0.82 :rotating_light:
Lina S: seeing the alert. looks like the newer quantized kernel caused pinching on recall tests. any customer-visible errors?
DeployBot: error-rate unchanged; degradation surfaced on our similarity/recall evals and a couple of customer testcases flagged lower matches. rolling average impact small but concentrated in two dedicated pools.
Raj P: pinging — AcmeCorp and BrightHealth are on those pools. Sales want a heads-up before we flip anything that could change output. If auto-revert runs it may change outputs briefly.
Coco C: agree. CS wants to prep a short note and offer an engineering touchpoint. prefer manual rollback with coordinated customer comms.
ReleaseMgr: operational choices: allow auto-revert (confidence high) and risk surprise, or suppress and do staged manual rollback to regions/pools with customer comms?
Lina S: propose staged approach: 1) suppress auto-revert, 2) pin affected pools to v4.0.9, 3) perform region-scoped rollback us-west-2 first, run smoke, then eu-central-1. minimizes blast radius and gives Sales/CS time to notify.
DeployBot: recommended commands:
```
# suppress auto-revert for this rollout
redwood deploy annotate --release=v4.1.0 --key=auto_revert --value=suppressed_by_ops
# pin prior version to specific targets
redwood release pin v4.0.9 --targets=dedicated-pool-7,dedicated-pool-9
# rollback per-region scope
redwood deploy rollback --to v4.0.9 --scope=dedicated-pool-7 --region=us-west-2
redwood deploy rollback --to v4.0.9 --scope=dedicated-pool-9 --region=eu-central-1
```
Raj P: I'll draft customer notes for AcmeCorp/BrightHealth and ask for permission to send right before the us-west-2 rollback. we should cc their SREs and offer a short scheduled call.
OncallBot: NOTE: change window closes at 01:15 UTC. if rollout/rollback crosses window boundary, ops must notify affected tenants and change control.
ReleaseMgr: we have ~18m on the window. Lina, can you do us-west-2 revert first and report smoke within 10m? Raj/Coco will be on standby for comms.
Lina S: starting pin now, will execute rollback to us-west-2 in 2m.
Lina S: pin command succeeded. initiating us-west-2 rollback.
Lina S: us-west-2 rollback complete. running smoke scripts against canary tenant in pool-7.
Lina S: smoke results: recall restored to within 0.9% of baseline, latency normal. logs show no errors.
Raj P: sending brief customer note to AcmeCorp now: "We observed a regression in embedding recall for a small subgroup after our recent model update. We have reverted your environment to the previous model to restore expected behavior and are investigating. If you'd like a sync with engineering, reply and we'll schedule. — Raj (Sales)"
Coco C: sending similar short message to BrightHealth, cc'ing SRE. also posting internal CS playbook link.
ReleaseMgr: good. proceed with eu-central-1 rollback after confirm from Raj/Coco that customer notifications went out.
Raj P: AcmeCorp acknowledged. BrightHealth on board with a scheduled 30m follow-up tomorrow. proceed with eu-central-1.
Lina S: executing eu-central-1 rollback now.
Lina S: eu-central-1 rollback finished. smoke: recall within 1.1% baseline, embedding eval pass.
DeployBot: audit: manual rollback executed by Lina S; auto-revert suppressed by operator annotation.
ReleaseMgr: please file postmortem ticket and include timeline, affected tenant IDs, smoke outputs, and the decision to suppress auto-revert. Tag eng-ml, infra, sales, and cs. Also update release notes: short blurb + link to status page.
Lina S: created PM-4599: https://pm.internal/4599 — assigned to eng-ml/infra. attached logs and smoke report.
Raj P: uploaded customer messages and ack receipts to the PM.
Coco C: updated the CS incident playbook with recommended language and next steps.
OncallBot: change window extended to cover postmortem ops tasks per ReleaseMgr request (+45m).
ReleaseMgr: follow-up actions: run full regression in staging on v4.1.0-alpha + quantized candidate, run comparison against our customer evaluation set, and only re-rollout after explicit go/no-go from eng-ml + Sales signoff for impacted tenants.
Lina S: noted. closing thread once PM and release notes updated. thanks team. :clap:
